sn22.69:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.69:1.3: sādhu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu …pe… pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.69:1.4: yaṃ kho bhikkhu anattaniyaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabboti.
sn22.69:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī’ti?
sn22.69:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante, anattaniyaṃ, tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.69:2.3: vedanā anattaniyā, tatra me chando pahātabbo,
sn22.69:2.5: saṅkhārā anattaniyā, tatra me chando pahātabbo,
sn22.69:2.6: viññāṇaṃ anattaniyaṃ, tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.69:2.7: imassa kho’haṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.69:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.69:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu, anattaniyaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.69:3.7: viññāṇaṃ anattaniyaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.69:3.8: imassa kho bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti atha kho so bhikkhu, bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā …pe…
sn22.69:3.9: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
